description: This file defines the 'Create' feature for articles, including data models, validation, command handling, and database interactions for creating a new article in the application.

classes.name: Create.ArticleData
classes.description: Data model representing article details such as title, description, body, and tags.

classes.name: Create.ArticleDataValidator
classes.description: Validation class for ArticleData that ensures required fields are populated.

classes.name: Create.Command
classes.description: Command object encapsulating an article creation request.

classes.name: Create.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validator for the Command object, ensuring the Article data is valid.

classes.name: Create.Handler
classes.description: Handles the article creation process, interacting with the database context.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the creation of a new article, including handling tags, saving to database, and returning the created article envelope.
